brand.name: Mowgli Games
brand.tagline: Soft, round, and a little silly.

sentence.en: Mowgli Games is an independent studio making soft, playful casual games that anyone can pick up and enjoy.
sentence.ko: 모글리 게임즈는 누구나 쉽게 시작하고 즐길 수 있는, 말랑하고 장난스러운 캐주얼 게임을 만드는 인디 스튜디오입니다.

set.name: Bagel Letters
set.mechanism: The name itself is the toy: fat, puffy lowercase letters that look squeezable, set warm yolk-yellow on cocoa dark, with nothing else drawn.
set.expression_move: The puffy wordmark; the palette and text face stay plain around it.
set.differs_by: A wordmark-only route: where most studios lead with a mascot, this one is recognised by its letters alone.

logo.concept: Puffy lowercase 'mowgli' that looks soft enough to squeeze.

defaults_used.why: The user asked for a deep yellow key colour on dark (questionnaire A11); the flagged tone is that same yellow and its darker step, not a separate gold accent added for warmth.

rationale.claim: Dark ground with a deep yellow key colour is the user's stated preference.
Bagel Fat One covers every base Korean and English character, so the same voice works on the Korean pages.
A wordmark-only route gives a real alternative to the symbol-plus-wordmark formula.

findings.message: light: primary #ffaa0a on background #ffffff is 1.91:1, below 3.0:1 (primary fill against the page (needs a label or border if lower); WCAG 2, no rounding)
light: border #e9e5e3 on background #ffffff is 1.25:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: link #ffaa0a on text #f5f2f1 is 1.71:1, below 3.0:1 (underline links in dark mode (WCAG G183: without underline a link needs 3:1 against body text); WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: border #5f524c on background #2a1d17 is 2.17:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
#ffaa0a sits at the sRGB gamut edge (100% of max chroma); vivid colours like this often fall outside CMYK process gamut: specify Lab D50 + tolerance, check with the printer, consider a spot colour
